note: Re-judged 2026-09-29. rfc7854_wire_header_test.go::TestRFC7854PerPeerHeaderFollowsTheCommonHeader writes all seven types and decodes a per-peer header at octet 6 of Route Monitoring, Statistics Report, Peer Down, Peer Up and Route Mirroring, requiring it to equal the header the writer was given (4-octet AS 4200000001); for Initiation and Termination it requires the first TLV (type 1, length 2) at octet 6 and a message too short to hold a per-peer header, which is the 'most' of the sentence. The older TestHasPeerHeader tags stay: hasPeerHeader has no non-test caller, so those two tags prove a helper table only.
